Role: Marketing
Industry: Design
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Shopify es una excelente platraforma en la que puedes crear una tienda en línea. No necesitas de tener un conocimiento avanzado de programación para su configuración. Su gestor de inventario es intuitivo. además, está optimizado para el SEO.
Cons: Aunque con Shopify puedes olvidarte de estar programando gracias a sus módulos, estos en su gran mayoría son de pago. y en algunos casos con costos elevados
Comments: Utilizo Shopify en proyectos en donde necesito enfocarme más por la gestión del negocio y no tengo mucho tiempo para la programación de la tienda online. Y hasta el momento no me ha defraudado.

Role: Interpreter
Industry: Transportation/Trucking/Railroad
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Le plan de base propose de très bons utiles d'analyses.
Cons: Les explications et plusieurs vidéos sont en anglais ce qui ne permet pas à plusieurs personnes de comprendre. En plus, le site est parfois un peu lent.
Comments: L'application est pratique, moins cher. La plateforme est de qualité et l'application fonctionne bien, parfait de garder un œil sur la boutique tout au long de la journée.

Role: Assistant Manager
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Intuitive interface, Reliable Hosting and Security. Responsive design ensures your store looks great and functions well on both desktop and mobile devices, crucial for today's e-commerce landscape.
Cons: While Shopify's pricing starts reasonably, additional expenses like transaction fees and app subscriptions can accumulate, impacting the overall cost of ownership with limited customization options.
Comments: Shopify empowers businesses to create and manage successful online stores, and with the right approach, it can be a valuable asset for e-commerce endeavors.

Role: Operations manager
Industry: Consumer Goods
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Shopify makes creating an online store incredibly easy and within reach to almost everyone.
Cons: Shopify customer support often leaves something to be desired. Sometimes you’ll get a stellar support agent who goes the extra mile to get your issue solved, but it’s unfortunately rare. I often end up feeling like I’m talking to an AI bot or explaining the issue over and over and over with no resolution.
Comments: Overall Shopify has been a very useful tool for my company. It was easy to grasp as a newbie, even for someone who is not super techy.
Reasons for choosing: Better rates and more features at the time.
Alternatives considered: Squarespace

Role: Data Trainer
Industry: Internet
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: I was able to build an e-store myself, even though I don't know how to code. The platform was highly customizable, and integrating other software was user-friendly.
Cons: It took a considerable amount of time to bring my vision to life on the screen. Prior digital marketing skills are highly recommended; otherwise, you may end up spending more than you earn.
Comments: I approached Shopify with high hopes and big dreams. I invested a significant amount of time in my e-store, but unfortunately, I didn't generate any sales before my free trial ended. I had hoped to at least make enough to cover the store fees.

Role: Bus monitor
Industry: Transportation/Trucking/Railroad
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The quick pay and tracking my payment and purchase
Cons: I pay my jewelry with Shopify. I see all the bill and good options
Comments: It's a good service u can trust
Reasons for choosing: Better with the bills I pay and in all

Role: Consultor
Industry: Architecture & Planning
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Su facilidad de uso, y mis compañeros en TI comparten el uso del mismo
Cons: Podría ser más abarcante, con un sistema de planificación integrado
Comments: Más que nada es de investigación académica / profesional en cursos de planificación y diplomados TI
Reasons for choosing: Por su uso global entre profesionales y estudiantes

Role: Owner
Industry: Retail
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I have been using Shopify for a few years and it is becoming better with each new update. I decided to take the chance with shopify and i have never looked back
Cons: The down time when we can not access our website etc

Role: Mbita
Industry: Sporting Goods
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: L'inscription et le montage de la boutique
Cons: Les frais de payement,pour moi il faut au moins attendre 3mois pour imposer sa .
Comments: Très facile à utiliser,la commande très fluide et les articles très a journaux,et tendances j'aime

Role: Administrator
Industry: Food & Beverages
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: What I like the most about Shopify is that it's easy to use, it can help you create a business if you're a person looking to start making money.
Cons: Everything about Shopify is good, I encountered no problems.
Comments: My overall experience is good, no problems and easy to use.

Role: Soporte
Industry: Industrial Automation
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Lo que mas me gusta de Squarespace es que no necesitas habilidades tecnicas para construir bonitas paginas web.
Cons: Lo que no me gusta es el precio. Es muy alto en comparacion con otros creadores de sitios web
Switched from: Duda
Alternatives considered: Wix|Divi

Role: Front Desk
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I love how easy it is to use for someone building their website for the first time it is a little overwhelming but it was no issues.
Cons: For a small business just starting out I wish there was cheaper options as you build your brand because you want to get your name out their with a website.
Comments: I truly have loved using it, its been so easy for someone that has never built a website before and so many different options to choose from.

Role: Owner operator
Industry: Cosmetics
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It was so simple to understand and easy to us.
Cons: I never had any issues with square space
Comments: Square space is user friendly and intuitive
Reasons for switching: Etsy was not working like needed it to, and I wanted something easier to integrate and use.
Switched from: EtsyMarketingTool

Role: UX designer and writer
Industry: Internet
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I really enjoy the ease of Squarespace. It is very upfront in its ability to ensure usability for beginners as well as more in-depth processes for experts. It's easy, fast, and offers a great amount of support.
Cons: While there are not many things I dislike about Squarespace, the very thing I enjoy is also a perplexing issue. Correct placement is a bit harder to achieve when using the website builder. Also, a colleague mentioned Squarespace, in the past, had problems with backing up work.
Comments: Overall I am completely pleased with Squarespace. I feel all of the pros highly outweigh any cons that are involved.
Reasons for choosing: I found Squarespace to be the entire package I was looking for with my needs in mind as a designer and writer.
Reasons for switching: I found the time it took to design with Squarespace, along with the results [truncated]

Role: Camp Leader
Industry: Recreational Facilities and Services
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I have used this software to create a website for a small business and it truly is easy to use and helps first time users understand all the steps quickly. It did not need alot of maintenance and does not require any coding of sorts
Cons: The software did not cause any issues when I was using it however I do find that it does not require enough navigating options

Role: Owner
Industry: Design
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: This product is super easy to use and designing websites has never been simpler. Very easy to get a website up and running from start to finish.
Cons: I wish there was more customization. I feel like there’s a lot more I’d like to do with squarespace but it has limited advanced customization and limited SEO options
Comments: Overall I was satisfied for the price although I would prefer more customization
Switched from: GoDaddy Website Builder

Role: CEO
Industry: Hospitality
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I liked that it was very user friendly. It was very simple and had a lot of features. I was able to add my team and it was easy for them to use as well.
Cons: It didn't have the capability to add pictures to shifts or take deposits from clients.
Comments: It was very good for the size of business that we had for quite a while. Ultimately I ended up upgrading to a dis-batching software later....but for a long time it was enough for our business.

Role: Owner
Industry: Retail
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: All of its features, the infrastructure is very easy to grasp. Learning how to use Squarespace is a piece of cake.
Cons: There is honestly nothing that I do not like about Squarespace.
Comments: Much better than I expected. From the set up, to the processing of payment and everything in between. It is just superb. It’s great for anyone who is new to starting a business, you don’t need to be a tech guru to get started and before you know it you’ll be ready to receive payments.

Role: Owner
Industry: Consumer Services
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 2
Ease-of-use rating: 1
Pros: The website design features, ease of use and affordability keeps me hanging on with this company but the most attractive thing about this company is their vast amount of partner integrations.
Cons: Customer service is a complete waste of time. The staff is not at all concerned with an issues that may arise, they cut you off during conversation and have even raised their voice at me.
Comments: I'm using them while trying to find a better alternative, I'm rooting for them, but I feel like the company may have too many cards in their hand at once, and not enough focus on anything in particular, at least not enough focus to not waste the amount of potential that they have for greatness, while looking to be the next best thing.
Switched from: Stripe

Role: Accounting Technician
Industry: Transportation/Trucking/Railroad
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Its intuitive and easy-to-use website builder. With a wide variety of templates and customization options, it's easy to create a stunning and professional-looking website without needing any coding experience.
Cons: I think that is the pricing, it can be more expensive than some other website builders on the market.
Comments: It was very good, as someone with limited coding experience, the platform interface and templates made it easy to create a professional-looking website.
